messages:
Maya (Growth): Planning note: we need a compact nurture ladder for the upcoming product newsletter. Goal: demo signups and docs traffic. Draft here: https://docs.redwood.ai/marketing/launch-nurture.

Priya (Content): I trimmed copy into a three-email ladder: 1) Launch announcement (hero + stat), 2) Deep dive (benchmarks + use cases), 3) Reminder + customer quote. Each email gets a micro-CTA (docs, demo, webinar).

Liam (Ops): ESP constraints: safe burst 100k/hr. Recommend geo-stagger NA then EMEA then APAC across 48h. Also confirm suppression lists: unsubscribes, trial_opt_outs, enterprise_rollout. I will export and share CSV by EOD.

Zoe (Email): Suggested segmentation: primary = active trials (last 30d), secondary = dormant trials (31-90d), tertiary = product users with no trial, control = small holdout (2%). Weight sends to engaged (opened >=1 email in 90d). Run a 2x2 subject/preheader test on email #1.

Maya (Growth): Add a conversion window of 7 days for demo signup and 14 days for docs events. UTMs: utm_campaign=launch_nurture&utm_medium=email&utm_source=newsletter. Also want a small re-engage path for non-openers at 72h.

Priya (Content): Draft subject lines for test: A) "Meet the new Redwood inference flow" B) "Ship LLM features with lower latency" Preheaders: short vs benefit-focused. I will shorten hero copy to include one clear benchmark line. Need legal to confirm the exact stat.

Liam (Ops): Plan for deliverability check: seed send 1k tomorrow 09:00 PT, monitor bounces and complaints for 2h. If bounce rate >2% pause and reroute remainder into a 3-email drip spaced 72h apart. I will set alerts to #release-war-room.

Zoe (Email): A/B allocation: 25% A, 25% B, 48% winner allocation, 2% holdout. Winning metric = open-to-demo conversion. Schedule: final copy by tomorrow noon, list ready by tonight, seed test tomorrow AM, main send starts Thursday 10:00 PT.

campaign-bot: Campaign workspace updated: "launch_nurture_ladder". Review meeting scheduled: tomorrow 10:00 AM PT.

Maya (Growth): Action items: Priya finalize subjects + hero stat (EOD), Liam export suppression list + run seed (today/tomorrow), Zoe wire up A/B test + UTMs (tomorrow AM).

Priya (Content): On it. I will also prepare alt hero imagery for mobile and desktop.

Liam (Ops): I will paste the suppression export here when ready.

Zoe (Email): Will post campaign preview screenshots and test results after seed.

Maya (Growth): Thanks all. Keep notes brief in this thread and ping if blockers.
